score_source_file: 005-Similarity calculations for the isomers in in-house database with longitudinal and cross-sectional profiling.ipynb
core_longitudinal_score: For each aligned fragment, compare its intensity vector across collision energies using squared cosine similarity or Jaccard (Tanimoto) similarity; rank fragment profiles by summed intensity and retain perfragment scores. Construction includes relative abundance normalization and aligned fragment groups. This description does not qualify the complete published plasma pipeline.
